Bodhapañcadaśikā

15 verses chanted, karaoke-timed · English shows only where the gate passed

1
अनस्तमितभारूपस् तेजसाम् तमसाम् अपि
य एको न्तर् यदन्तश् च तेजांसि च तमांसि च
anastamitabhārūpas tejasāṃ tamasām api |
ya eko 'ntar yadantaś ca tejāṃsi ca tamāṃsi ca ||
Of unsetting sun-light is His form — of bright powers and of darknesses too. For He is one, within, and powers and darknesses end in Him.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
2
स एव सर्वभूतानाम् स्वभावः परमेश्वरः
भावजातम् हि तस्यैव शक्तिर् ईश्वरतामयी
sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ svabhāvaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
bhāvajātaṃ hi tasyaiva śaktir īśvaratāmayī ||
He alone is the own-nature of all beings, the supreme Lord. And the whole host of things is His alone — power, shaped as Lordship.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
3
शक्तिश् च शक्तिमद्रूपाद् व्यतिरेकम् न वाञ्छति
तादात्म्यम् अनयोर् नित्यम् वह्निदाहिकयोर् इव
śaktiś ca śaktimadrūpād vyatirekam na vāñchati |
tādātmyam anayor nityaṃ vahnidāhikayor iva ||
Power wants no apartness from the power-bearer. The two are eternally one — as fire is one with its burning.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
4
स एव भैरवो देवो जगद्भरणलक्षणः
स्वात्मादृषे समग्रम् हि यच्छक्त्या प्रतिबिम्बितम्
sa eva bhairavo devo jagadbharaṇalakṣaṇaḥ |
svātmādṛṣe samagraṃ hi yacchaktyā pratibimbitam ||
He alone is Bhairava, the god whose very mark is bearing the world. In the mirror of His own self-seeing, the whole stands reflected — by power.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
5
तस्यैवैषा परा देवी स्वरूपामर्शनोत्सुका
पूर्णत्वम् सर्वभवेषु यस्या नाल्पम् न चाधिकम्
tasyaivaiṣā parā devī svarūpāmarśanotsukā |
pūrṇatvaṃ sarvabhaveṣu yasyā nālpaṃ na cādhikam ||
His alone is the supreme goddess, hungry only to grasp His own nature. She is fullness in all beings — in whom there is neither too little nor too much.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
6
एष देवो नया देव्या नित्यम् क्रीडारसोत्सुकः
विचित्रान् सृष्टिसंहारान् विधत्ते युगपद् विभुः
eṣa devo 'nayā devyā nityaṃ krīḍārasotsukaḥ |
vicitrān sṛṣṭisaṃhārān vidhatte yugapad vibhuḥ ||
This god, with this goddess, is forever eager for the joy of play. Varied makings and unmakings He works at once — everywhere at once.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
7
अतिदुर्घटकारित्वम् अस्यानुत्तरम् एव यत्
एतद् एव स्वतन्त्रत्वम् ऐस्वर्यम् बोधरूपता
atidurghaṭakāritvam asyānuttaram eva yat |
etad eva svatantratvam aisvaryaṃ bodharūpatā ||
What is hardest to do is His, and it is unsurpassed. That itself is His freedom, His lordship, His awareness-form.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
8
परिच्छिन्नप्रकाशत्वम् जडस्य किल लक्षणम्
जडाद् विलक्षणो बोधो यतो न परिमीयते
paricchinnaprakāśatvaṃ jaḍasya kila lakṣaṇam |
jaḍād vilakṣaṇo bodho yato na parimīyate ||
To shine only in part — that is the mark of the inert. Awareness is otherwise than the inert, for no measure contains it.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
9
एवम् अस्य स्वतन्त्रस्य निजशक्त्युपभेदिनः
स्वात्मगाः सृष्टिसंहाराः स्वरूपत्वेन संस्थिताः
evam asya svatantrasya nijaśaktyupabhedinaḥ |
svātmagāḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārāḥ svarūpatvena saṃsthitāḥ ||
So it is with the free one, distinguishing by His own power: makings and unmakings rest in His own self, standing as His very nature.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
10
तेषु वैचित्र्यम् अत्यन्तम् ऊर्ध्वाधस् तिर्यग् एव यत्
भुवनानि तदंशाश् च सुखदुःखमतिश् च या
teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat |
bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā ||
In them, variety runs to the extreme — upward, downward, across. Worlds and their fragments, pleasure and pain and mind.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
11
यद् एतस्यापरिज्ञानम् तत्स्वातन्त्र्यम् हि वर्णितम्
स एव खलु संसारो मूडानाम् यो विभीषकः
yad etasyāparijñānaṃ tatsvātantryaṃ hi varṇitam |
sa eva khalu saṃsāro mūḍānāṃ yo vibhīṣakaḥ ||
Not to know this is called His freedom. And that is saṃsāra itself — a terror to the deluded.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
12
तत्प्रसादरसाद् एव गुर्वागमत एव वा
शास्त्राद् वा परमेशस्य यस्मात् कस्माद् उपागतम्
tatprasādarasād eva gurvāgamata eva vā |
śāstrād vā parameśasya yasmāt kasmād upāgatam ||
From the sap of His grace, or from the teacher's handed word, or from the Lord's own scripture — from whichever, it is reached.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
13
यत् तत्त्वस्य परिज्ञानम् स मोक्षः परमेशतः
तत् पूर्णत्वम् प्रबुद्धानाम् जीवन्मुक्तिश् च सा स्मृता
yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ |
tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā ||
To know reality through and through — that is release, from the supreme Lord. That is the fullness of the awakened: freedom while living, as the remembered teaching holds.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
14
एतौ बन्धविमोक्षौ च परमेशस्वरूपतः
न भिद्येते न भेदो हि तत्त्वतः परमेश्वरे
etau bandhavimokṣau ca parameśasvarūpataḥ |
na bhidyete na bhedo hi tattvataḥ parameśvare ||
Bondage and release both come of the Lord's own nature. The two do not split apart; in truth, in the supreme Lord, there is no split.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
15
इत्थम् इच्छाकलाज्ञानशक्तिशूलाम्बुजाश्रितः
भैरवः सर्वभावानाम् स्वभावः परिशील्यते
ittham icchākalājñānaśaktiśūlāmbujāśritaḥ |
bhairavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ svabhāvaḥ pariśīlyate ||
So it is: resting on the lotus of the trident — will, art, knowledge, power — Bhairava, the own-nature of all things, is to be dwelt upon.
studio chant · anushtubh · align 0.0
